name: ComBat Operator
description: ComBat batch correction (L or L/S model), optionally with a reference batch or fitted on a fit condition only. Returns the corrected values (CmbCor) and a before/after PCA plot.

metaFactors.name: Samples
metaFactors.description: Factors defining one sample per column (e.g. Barcode, Array/Row), plus the factors used by the fit condition (e.g. Grouping).

metaFactors.name: Values
metaFactors.description: Normalized values (log- or VSN-transformed, not S100).

metaFactors.name: Batch
metaFactors.description: Technical batch factor(s), e.g. Run or Barcode. Several factors are combined into one batch.

properties.name: ModelType
properties.description: L/S corrects the level and the spread of each batch; L corrects only the level. See README.

properties.name: UseReferenceBatch
properties.description: Keep one batch unchanged and map all other batches onto it.

properties.name: ReferenceBatch
properties.description: The reference batch: a value of the batch (colour) factor, e.g. 650097104. With several colour factors give one value per factor, in colour order, separated by ';' (e.g. run01;650097104).

properties.name: UseFitCondition
properties.description: Fit the correction only on the samples of the fit condition (e.g. reference/control samples) and apply it to all samples.

properties.name: FitConditionFactors
properties.description: Column factor(s) defining the fit condition, separated by ';' (e.g. Grouping, or Supergroup;Test Condition). The factors must be on the crosstab columns.

properties.name: FitConditionValues
properties.description: Value(s) of the fit-condition factors, one per factor separated by ';' (e.g. REF, or Control;DMSO). Several conditions are separated by '|' (e.g. Control;DMSO | Control;Vehicle).
